summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of YABBAI Command Centre platform. All 11 pages tested successfully with full navigation, UI interactions, and backend API integration verified. Backend APIs 100% functional, frontend 100% functional.
passed_tests: Backend: Health check API (/api/) returns 200 with status ok
Backend: Token mint CRUD operations (GET/POST/DELETE) working correctly
Backend: Jupiter price proxy (/api/jupiter-price) working with graceful error handling
Backend: Solana balance proxy (/api/solana-balance) working with real blockchain data
Backend: Input validation working (invalid mint address returns 400)
Frontend: All 11 navigation links present and functional
Frontend: Command Centre (/) - Hero with YABBAI header loads, phase tracker shows 5 phases, live stats grid displays 8 values with ticking animation, live events stream shows scrolling logs

Frontend: YABBAI Token (/yabbai) - Price chart renders with green glowing line, Jupiter swap interface has FROM/TO fields and slippage controls, Mission Phase card shows 5 progress bars, SWEEP ALL YIELDS button works with confirmation animation

Frontend: Launch (/launch) - Launchpad selection works with 4 options (pump.fun, Meteora, Raydium, Orca), mint address input accepts valid Solana addresses, launch button triggers sequence animation with console output

Frontend: Payment Engine (/payment) - 12 payment rails visible with live/sandbox status, PayPal AutoPayout toggle works and shows live engine stats, Real vs Mock ledger table filters work (BOTH/REAL/MOCK buttons)

Frontend: Mission Builder (/mission) - 3 AI parameter sliders work (Autonomy, Risk, Reinvestment), Generate Mission Plan button triggers console animation with 7 steps, 7 value chips are clickable and toggle locked state, generated mission plan displays with code syntax
Frontend: Wallet (/wallet) - Connect Phantom button present and clickable, wallet address lookup input works with scan button
Frontend: Withdraw Portal (/withdraw) - SOL transfer form present with recipient and amount fields, send button present with Phantom wallet integration prompt
Frontend: API Pulse (/api-pulse) - 20 API cards visible with live status, latency, and call counts, waveform canvas animates smoothly, CASCADE MODE toggle works and changes waveform visualization

Frontend: BASHAM Gold Harvester (/basham) - Gold theme (#d4a017) with dark background (#0a0a08), business audit form with 5 questions, pain points list shows 6 items with severity badges, tabs (AUDIT/MAP/STREAMS/COLONIES) work correctly

Frontend: Side Hustle Protocol (/side-hustle) - Signal feed shows 6 leads with business details, call scripts tab displays 2 script templates, add lead form works with business name, pain signal, and value inputs

Frontend: Promo Generator (/promo) - Canvas preview renders with grid and waveform, template select dropdown works with 5 templates, theme controls work (YABBAI/BASHAM), generate button creates promo and adds to history
